create_scavenger_environment: create a Scavenger environment with a configurable arena size, number of object channels, and max steps per episode
run_scavenger_episode: run a Scavenger episode by resetting the environment and stepping through UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT actions
build_sequential_rewarder: build a SequentialCollectionRewarder that rewards collecting objects in ascending order by channel index
build_balanced_rewarder: build a BalancedCollectionRewarder that rewards collecting objects to balance counts across all channels
get_scavenger_observation: get the egocentric or allocentric arena observation with object positions, walls, and collected resource cumulants
